sn9.3:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Kassapagotto Kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || 2.
sn9.3:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Kassapagotto divāvihāragato aññataraṃ chetaṃ ovadati || || 3.
sn9.3:1.3: Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā āyasmato Kassapagottassa anukampikā atthakāmā āyasmantaṃ Kassapagottaṃ saṃvejetukāmā yenāyasmā Kassapagotto tenupasaṅkami || || 4. Upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Kassapagottaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn9.3:5.1: Atha kho āyasmā Kassapagotto tāya devatāya saṃvejito saṃvegam āpādīti || || 1.
